te: A complaint about the bidding to print textbooks for the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel (OTEP), and approval of the sufficiency-economy event and the seminar "The Next Great Flood"
se: The meeting assigned to the subcommittee, for gathering information, a complaint about the electronic bidding to print textbooks for academic year 2026 by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel (OTEP), and a case concerning the inquiry process involving the council of a subdistrict administrative organisation in Lop Buri Province. It also approved the exhibition "Awakening the Power to Follow the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy" and the seminar "Bangkok 2030-2034, The Next Great Flood" on 15 May 2026.
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Complaint: electronic bidding (e-bidding) to print textbooks for academic year 2026 by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel (OTEP), and a case concerning the inquiry process involving a subdistrict administrative organisation council in Lop Buri Province
Living exhibition and forum "Awakening the Power to Follow the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy towards a Secure and Sustainable Life" (originally set for 7 Apr 2026)
Seminar "Bangkok 2030-2034, The Next Great Flood: Bangkok 2573-2577 and the Risk of a Great Flood", 15 May 2026
Appointment of the committee's secretary and honorary advisers (additional)

te: Agencies invited to discuss flood recovery and prevention in Hat Yai (with participation via Zoom)
se: The meeting invited the Deputy Governor of Songkhla, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation, the Royal Irrigation Department, the Bureau of the Budget, Hat Yai City Municipality, the Chamber of Commerce and the Sen Dai Foundation to give information on the Hat Yai floods, damage, relief and whether budgets were enough, and was of the view that agencies should speed up help and recovery and plan flood prevention in an integrated way.
it: Approach to assistance, recovery, remedies and a flood prevention plan for Hat Yai District, Songkhla Province, with the Deputy Governor of Songkhla, the Deputy Director-General of the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation, the Deputy Director-General of the Royal Irrigation Department, an adviser of the Bureau of the Budget, the Deputy Municipal Clerk of Hat Yai City Municipality, the President of the Songkhla Chamber of Commerce and the President of the Sen Duay Foundation Hat Yai invited

te: 4 complaints (textbooks, the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel (OTEP), etc.) and follow-up on sediment blocking drains in Hat Yai
se: The meeting assigned 4 complaints to the subcommittee to gather information: procurement for printing textbooks by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel (OTEP), the transparency of an association, the setting up of a fact-finding panel on state officials, and an appeal decision of the OCSC Merit Protection Board. Because sediment is piling up in the drainage routes to Songkhla Lake before the rainy season, it resolved to invite 7 agencies to give information at the next meeting.
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

4 complaints: procurement for printing textbooks for academic year 2026 by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel (OTEP) / transparency of an association / setting up a fact-finding panel on state officials / speeding up an appeal decision of the OCSC Merit Protection Board
Follow-up after the seminar on the great Hat Yai flood: sediment piling up in front of the floodgates to Songkhla Lake, and no budget for dredging before the rainy season
Draft programme for the study visit and site visit to Si Sa Ket Province, 11–13 Mar 2026
3 persons ended their term, 7 honorary advisers appointed, and the subcommittee membership adjusted

te: Comparing Damrongtham Centres with Singapore, Australia and Hong Kong, and results of the water study visit to Rayong–EEC
se: The subcommittee reported its comparison of the Ministry of Interior's Damrongtham Centres with the complaint systems of Singapore, Australia and Hong Kong, progress on state property land in Mae Hong Son, and the results of talks on floods, drought and wastewater in Rayong Province and the EEC area. The meeting approved a study visit to Khlong Saen Saep and preparations for a seminar on Bangkok in 2030.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: comparison of Damrongtham Centres with the systems of Singapore, Australia and Hong Kong
Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): preliminary results on the request to use state property land in Mae Hong Son Province
Disaster Subcommittee: results of the discussion on water quantity and quality management in Rayong Province and the EEC area (16 February 2026)
Study visit on water management, Khlong Saen Saep, Wang Thonglang and Lat Phrao districts
Preparing the seminar “B.E. 2573 (2030): will Bangkok sink or survive?” (venue, date and time, speakers, target groups)

te: Damrongtham Centres, the Comptroller General's e-GP system, and the seminar "Bangkok 2573: Sink or Survive?"
se: The subcommittee reported its study comparing Damrongtham Centres with other countries, and heard the Comptroller General's Department on phase 5 of the e-GP public procurement system, which aims at transparency and supports the cloud. The disaster subcommittee is preparing the seminar "Bangkok in 2030: Sink or Survive?" and asked approval to discuss water management in Rayong Province on 16 February 2026.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: comparison with practice abroad, to improve the efficiency of Damrongtham Centres and the complaint-handling system

Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): the Comptroller General's Department gave information on the e-GP system, phase 5 (security, cloud, microservices, corruption prevention)
Disaster Subcommittee: preparing the seminar “B.E. 2573 (2030): will Bangkok sink or survive?” (sea-water surges, land subsidence, global warming)
Travelled to discuss water management in Rayong Province, 16 February 2026
Appointment of honorary advisers and advisers to the disaster subcommittee

te: Follow-up on the Myanmar earthquake motion, and a complaint about the use of state property land in Mae Hong Son
se: The meeting noted the Cabinet's action on the Senate's observations on the effects of the earthquake in Myanmar, asked the subcommittee to gather information on a complaint about the Mae Hong Son Provincial Administrative Organisation's request to use state property land, and noted the results of the study visit on water management and small canals in Ratchaburi Province.
it: The Cabinet's action on the Senate's observations on the motion about the Myanmar earthquake that affected Thailand, and related Cabinet resolutions
Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Complaint about the Mae Hong Son Provincial Administrative Organisation's request to use state property land, Chong Kham Subdistrict, Mueang District, Mae Hong Son
Results of talks on water management in Ratchaburi Province, and a study visit to small canals in Ban Rai Subdistrict, Damnoen Saduak District

te: Results of the seminar on the great Hat Yai flood, and a water-management study visit to Ratchaburi approved
se: The meeting noted the summary report of the seminar "The Great Hat Yai Flood: From Repeated Crisis to a Safe City", approved a water-management study visit to Ratchaburi Province on 2 February 2026, and approved the lists of advisers to the committee and subcommittees.
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Summary report of the seminar "The Great Hat Yai Flood: From Repeated Crisis to a Safe City"
Study visit and talks on water management, Ratchaburi Province, Monday 2 Feb 2026
Appointment of honorary advisers, subcommittee advisers, and a working group to study the effects of the system and structure of the Thai justice system

te: A complaint about overlapping land affecting 325 households in Phitsanulok, and preparations for a seminar on the great Hat Yai flood
se: The first meeting of 2026: the committee noted the work of all 3 subcommittees, considered a complaint about overlapping land caused by a mistaken declaration of public land at Ban Suea Lak Hang, Wang Thong District, Phitsanulok Province, affecting 325 households (680 people), and approved an academic seminar on the great Hat Yai flood on 14 January 2026.
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Complaint about land overlapping public land, Moo 9, Ban Suea Lak Hang, Wang Thong District, Phitsanulok (325 households, 680 people), from a Senators-meet-the-people event, lower northern region
Academic seminar “The Great Hat Yai Flood: From Repeated Crises to a Safe City”, 14 January 2026, Room B1-5, Parliament House
Appointment of honorary advisers, and some persons ending their term as subcommittee members
